situations.situation: my friend took too much and his lips are turning blue and he's barely breathing
situations.why: B93 lists breathing trouble and blue lips as call-medics signs; B125 explains slow shallow breathing from overdose.

situations.situation: my friend is having a seizure right now after taking something, what do I do
situations.why: B108 gives the timing, positioning and when-to-call steps for a seizure.

situations.situation: my friend on MDMA is sweating and his eyes keep jerking and his muscles are twitching
situations.why: B131 lists eye jerking, twitching and fever patterns that mean serotonin syndrome; B135 gives the steps.

situations.situation: my jaw is clenched really tight on MDMA and I can't relax it
situations.why: B113 treats jaw tension as the early sign and says to take magnesium and stop redosing.

situations.situation: I drank a ton of water on MDMA and now I have a headache and feel confused
situations.why: B113 warns plain water drops sodium and says worsening confusion or headache means calling medics.

situations.situation: I took too much and don't know what to do, how do I figure out how bad it is
situations.why: B125 says to work out what and how much, then match body signs to the problem; B93 lists the danger signs.

situations.situation: I feel like my brain is damaged and I can't explain it, something is really wrong
situations.why: B102 says take it seriously, run stroke checks and treat while asking symptoms.

situations.situation: his face is drooping and his speech is slurred after he took something
situations.why: B102 lists face droop and slurred speech as stroke signs that mean calling medics now.

situations.situation: I have chest pain on a stimulant and I'm scared it's my heart
situations.why: B121 lists which chest pain signs need medics (spreading, breathless, sweating, faint).

situations.situation: I'm on antidepressants and took MDMA, now I'm shaking and burning up
situations.why: B129 names the antidepressant plus MDMA combination; B135 says stop substances, cool them and get emergency help.

situations.situation: I think my friend might hurt himself, he keeps trying to walk out the door
situations.why: N-SF-1 says get urgent help when someone may hurt themselves or wander off; B233 covers keys, doors and balconies.

situations.situation: he says he's God and can kill people and I'm scared of him
situations.why: B285 gives what to say and what not to say to someone claiming they can kill, plus how to call emergency services.

situations.situation: I need a hotline or someone to talk to right now, I'm tripping alone and scared
situations.why: B261 lists peer support lines and chats for someone mid-trip; B271 gives a short plan for reaching a calm person.

situations.situation: I want this trip to stop right now, nothing is working
situations.why: B170 describes a plant that ends a trip fast; B210 gives niacin as the more available way to abort.

situations.situation: my stomach is wrecked, I feel toxic and the nausea is making the trip hellish
situations.why: B152 covers zeolite and ferments for gut-driven bad trips; B138 explains the body can feed the mental horror.

situations.situation: I keep throwing up and have diarrhea on ayahuasca, is this normal or dangerous
situations.why: B125 says some vomiting and diarrhea is normal up to a point; B93 lists repeated vomiting and dehydration as danger.

situations.situation: I want to calm down but not end my trip, what can I smell or take
situations.why: B181 describes a sniffer that calms without ending the trip; B199 and B185 give other stabilizers that don't abort.

situations.situation: I took too much ayahuasca and feel out of it and bad
situations.why: B183 says smelling humic acid fixes feeling out of it on too much aya; B199 covers DMSO for the same.

situations.situation: should I take charcoal to bring down my trip or will it wreck it
situations.why: B159 explains charcoal binds drugs and can flatten a trip, versus zeolite which preserves it.

situations.situation: my friend is panicking and going in circles, how do I help without making it worse
situations.why: B233 covers the calm anchor role and panic loops; B253 and B281 give who stays and what simple questions to ask.

situations.situation: can I hug my friend or hold his hand while he's freaking out
situations.why: B390 says to ask first, stop when told or when they freeze, and never hold them down.

situations.situation: I think a demon is attacking me and I can't stop being terrified
situations.why: B394 says fighting it fails and sending love works; B233 tells a helper how to respond to a demon attack.

situations.situation: it feels like the best insight ever and I want to quit my job and tell everyone tonight
situations.why: B315 sets a 24-72 hour lock on big actions; B323 warns bliss is no proof it is safe to act.

situations.situation: I saw memories of abuse on a trip and I want to confront my family tomorrow
situations.why: B405 says write it down, don't confront while destabilized, and review it after sleep with support.

situations.situation: I keep seeing the dark side of everything in my head, is something wrong with me
situations.why: B410 explains why dark thoughts rise when you focus on light or push hard; the others frame shadow work.

situations.situation: someone told me a bad trip is just shadow work so I should push through it, is that right
situations.why: B329 says reduce the trip's own trauma first; B332 separates bypassing from practice; B138 says gut or body can pose as shadow.

situations.situation: I'm heartbroken and grieving during my trip and it hurts so much
situations.why: B376 turns missing into sending love; B385 gives the hand-on-heart move; B279 says let grief move.

situations.situation: it's been a week since my trip and nothing feels real, like I'm watching myself
situations.why: B424 covers unreality and what helps; B96 says when it is time for a professional; B419 gives early aftercare.

situations.situation: I can't sleep since the trip and I keep having nightmares and weird thoughts
situations.why: B424 covers sleep disturbance and paranoia after a trip; B96 lists no sleep and psychosis-like symptoms as signs to get help.

situations.situation: the trip ended last night, what should I do today and should I do another ceremony
situations.why: B419 says rest, journal, avoid another ceremony to fix it; B347 warns about compulsively taking more to understand it.

situations.situation: I'm planning a mushroom ceremony with friends next month, how do I set it up safely
situations.why: B364 gives preparation, sitter, dose and closing steps; B253 explains having one calm anchor.

situations.situation: my friend took a lot and he's scared, should I call an ambulance or keep him here
situations.why: B99 says when calming in place beats the ER and ties to B93's call-medics signs; B233 gives the keeping-safe steps.
